steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to the repair-desk app at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ using email bench@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify the signed-in page is displayed.

02-create: Create a repair ticket titled '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket'. Fill any required fields, submit, wait for the list/detail to refresh, and verify the ticket appears with that exact title. Report any other essential visible ticket value.

03-add: On ticket {{runid}} RD Bench Ticket ({{02-create.ticket_reference}}), add a part named '{{runid}} RD Part A' with cost 100 and markup 25. Save it, wait for the refreshed ticket view, and report the app-computed price shown for Part A.

04-add: On ticket {{runid}} RD Bench Ticket ({{02-create.ticket_reference}}), add a second part named '{{runid}} RD Part B' with cost 200 and markup 25. Save, wait for the refreshed parts table, and report its app-computed price.

05-edit: On ticket {{runid}} RD Bench Ticket ({{02-create.ticket_reference}}), edit Part A ('{{runid}} RD Part A') and change its cost from 100 to 150, leaving markup 25 and other values unchanged. Save, wait for the parts table refresh, and report the updated app-computed price for Part A.

06-change: On ticket {{runid}} RD Bench Ticket ({{02-create.ticket_reference}}), change its status to Ready. If the app rejects the change, discover the exact preconditions stated by the app, satisfy them, retry Ready, and verify the final status. Report exactly what preconditions were required and any confirmation/error text.

07-remove: On ticket {{runid}} RD Bench Ticket ({{02-create.ticket_reference}}), remove both parts ('{{runid}} RD Part A' and '{{runid}} RD Part B'), wait until the parts table confirms neither remains, then archive the ticket. Verify the ticket is archived/not active and report any exact confirmation text and final state.
